title: Cokret Push Gateway Operation DTOs
description: Closed request and response DTOs for ck.edge.push.command.register_device, ck.edge.push.command.unregister_device, and ck.push.notify.

push_target_id.description: Pairwise pseudonym for one (recipient_service_did, principal, device, push_route) tuple. It MUST NOT be a DID, DID URL, Realm id, Strand id, Message id, Event id, or stable cross-Realm correlation key.

push_route_token.description: Opaque service-generated routing token. It MUST NOT contain, encode, or be reversibly derived from a DID, DID URL, Realm id, Circle id, Strand id, Message id, Event id, handle, platform push token, or stable cross-context correlation key.

registration_id.description: Push gateway local registration id. It is not a registered ck:<kind> protocol object id.

badge.description: Coarse unread indicator. Under blind_wakeup it MUST NOT carry a plaintext absolute unread count (activity side channel); only a boolean presence flag or a policy-declared bucket string is allowed. See push-notifications.md §5.1.

target_route_token.description: Gateway-internal mention-redirect routing token for this device route. Paired with notification.route_tokens.mention_redirect_target_route_tokens to drive the fail-closed per-device routing gate. MUST be stripped before any provider call; MUST NOT be forwarded to a provider. See push-notifications.md §4.5 / §5.1.

visible_notification_opt_in.description: Receiver device authorization state for ck.profile.push_gateway.visible_notification.v1. Missing or false means this device MUST receive only blind_wakeup output even if the caller service is plaintext-visible; visible metadata requires an explicit per-device opt-in.

route_tokens.description: Gateway-internal opaque routing fragment shared by blind and visible notifications. Every field here drives gateway-side routing / dedup / circuit-breaker state and MUST be stripped before the gateway calls any push provider; it MUST NOT be forwarded to a provider. Tokens are issued by the recipient Sync or Principal Service and bound to recipient_service_did, push gateway service DID, purpose, scope, and salt epoch.

realm_route_token.description: Opaque token for Realm-level routing / dedup / circuit-breaker keying.

scope_route_token.description: Opaque token for the effective Realm or Circle scope of this wakeup.

mention_redirect_target_route_tokens.description: Mention-redirect routing allow-list. When non-empty, each device's device_route.target_route_token MUST appear here or that device is failed closed (no provider call, no body decryption). Gateway-internal; MUST be stripped before any provider call. See push-notifications.md §4.5.

delivery_binding_frontier_token.description: Opaque token representing the receiver's delivery-binding frontier for stale-route detection.

audit_envelope.description: `ck.audit.accessed` envelope routing fragment carried alongside a notify request. When present, the request is an audit-pipeline event (e.g. an `e2ee_late_recovery` access notice), not a push notify: the gateway writes the audit event, acks 200, and skips the push pipeline.

access_kind.description: ck.audit.accessed.access_kind. The gateway branches on `e2ee_late_recovery` to skip the push pipeline.

late_recovery_original_event_id.description: REQUIRED (at the application layer) when access_kind == e2ee_late_recovery. References the original event the late recovery targets.

push_hint.description: Sanitized hint sentinel. When the value is "l10n_key" the actual localization key MUST be carried in push_hint_l10n_key (this enum value is a form selector, not a literal display token). See push-notifications.md §5.1 / §4.5.

push_hint_l10n_key.description: Localization key value, only present (and required) when push_hint == "l10n_key". MUST be an l10n key token, never plaintext body or any identifying metadata.

evaluation_locus_unresolved.description: Set true when the client has been woken but server-side rule matching is not yet resolved (E2EE client-side rule fallback). Pure local-evaluation signal; carries no metadata. See push-notifications.md §4.5.

push_hint.description: Sanitized hint sentinel. When the value is "l10n_key" the actual localization key MUST be carried in push_hint_l10n_key (this enum value is a form selector, not a literal display token). See push-notifications.md §5.1 / §4.5.

push_hint_l10n_key.description: Localization key value, only present (and required) when push_hint == "l10n_key".

evaluation_locus_unresolved.description: Set true when the client has been woken but server-side rule matching is not yet resolved. See push-notifications.md §4.5.

push_notify_request_body.description: Closed Cokret notify body. Product-private notification bodies, provider adapter payloads, APNs/FCM/WebPush data dictionaries, `content`, `content_*`, `provider_payload`, DND/snooze state, and push-rule plaintext are outside this wire surface and MUST be consumed before this body is built. Provider-facing payloads are reconstructed by the gateway from this closed shape and MUST strip route_tokens / reason_code / event_kind / audit_envelope before provider dispatch.

event_kind.description: Originating Event kind (e.g. `ck.message`) used by the gateway to route Phase-P2 `ck.agent.*` lifecycle / actor-private kinds to a no-fanout ack. Coarse routing selector; carries no Realm / sender / event identifier.

reason_code.description: Caller-supplied wire-safe reason code. The well-known value `historical_only` marks a diagnostic replay that MUST NOT trigger a fresh push fanout (the gateway answers a 200 idempotency-style ack). Other values are honored only where the operation defines them.
